todo: Standard 5-4-3-2-1 sensory grounding. Wording needs clinical review before real use.
lede: Five senses, counting down. It works by giving your attention somewhere duller to be.

steps.hint: Ordinary things. A door handle counts.
The floor, your sleeve, the chair, the air.
Or two smells you'd know anywhere.
Or one slow breath instead. Either is fine.

completion.title: That's the whole thing
completion.body: You can run it again from the top as many times as you want. Nothing here is counting.
